data.narrative:
Blykalla is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Janne Wallenius and Peter Szakalos that has raised $60M+ to date. The valuation universe comprises 11 nuclear energy peers: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Valar Atomics, Helion, Oklo, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $60M raised proxy, standard for Series B-to-next-stage step-ups in the sector, yielding $114M. Peer-median comparison is not applicable due to insufficient narrow peer data—while 6 same-sector comparables exist, none of the filtered subsets (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers) met the three-datapoint threshold required for statistical reliability. An all-sector median would introduce excessive noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $97M to $131M, centered at $114M. This range reflects a ±15% confidence band around the stage-progression result. The primary uncertainty is calibration to true market-rate multiples for Series B nuclear companies; more granular peer staging and recent transaction data would strengthen conviction. Secondary uncertainties include revenue trajectory assumptions embedded in the step-up methodology and the sustainability of capital deployment rates in the current nuclear funding environment.
